content.phase: checked fighter/capital content; disarmed before boss

window.availability: unconditional: disable_basic_rom forces PORTB bit 1 and writes BASICF at every stage-2 entry

boundedBy.above: sector reader BSS $BC00-$BC19, then the guard and the OS screen $BC20-$BFFF (RAMTOP $C0 when BASIC is disabled at coldstart)

window.guard: HYBRID_C_WINDOW_GUARD $BC1A-$BC1F, reserved with no segment, plus the ld65 assert "HYBRID_C_WINDOW reaches the sector reader BSS at $BC00"
window.contents: Director: HYBRID_ASM_WINDOW + HYBRID_C_WINDOW + HYBRID_C_WINDOW_RODATA + HYBRID_C_WINDOW_FLOW + HYBRID_C_WINDOW_HEAVY + HYBRID_C_WINDOW_HEAVY_RODATA + HYBRID_ASM_HEAVY_WINDOW + HYBRID_C_WINDOW_LOOK

transport.record: own DFMC record, LZ, stagingId extension
transport.landing: direct: stage 2 decodes it to AE00 after disable_basic_rom
